domain: Industrial power-transmission belts (classical wrapped, wedge, raw-edge cogged, Poly-V ...)
description: Canonical belt-telemetry schema. Every uploaded dataset is mapped onto these names before training. 'range' is the physically plausible range in the canonical unit and is only used for sanity warnings. Failure thresholds are NOT defined here - they belong to each belt type (see Belt Types); 'default_failure_threshold' is only used to sanity-check a mapping before a belt type is chosen.

belt_id.label: Belt / drive ID
belt_id.description: Unique identifier of the installed belt (or belt set on one drive)

belt_type.label: Belt type / section
belt_type.description: Belt type or section code, e.g. 'Poly-F Plus', 'SPB', 'BX'. Matched to the Belt Types configured in the app

hour.label: Operating hours
hour.description: Operating hours of the belt since installation at the time of the reading

timestamp.label: Reading timestamp
timestamp.description: Date/time of the reading. Converted to hours since the belt's first reading when 'hour' is not available

driver_pulley_dia_mm.label: Driver pulley diameter
driver_pulley_dia_mm.description: Pitch diameter of the driving (usually smaller) pulley

driven_pulley_dia_mm.label: Driven pulley diameter
driven_pulley_dia_mm.description: Pitch diameter of the driven pulley

num_pulleys.label: Pulleys on drive
num_pulleys.description: Number of pulleys/idlers the belt bends around per revolution

driver_rpm.label: Driver speed
driver_rpm.description: Rotational speed of the driving pulley

load_pct.label: Load
load_pct.description: Transmitted power as a percentage of rated power

slip_pct.label: Slip
slip_pct.description: Speed loss between driver and driven pulley relative to the ideal ratio

vibration_mms.label: Vibration
vibration_mms.description: Drive vibration velocity (RMS) - captures belt whip, misalignment, shock loads

maintenance_count.label: Re-tension count
maintenance_count.description: Number of re-tensioning / maintenance actions since installation

belt_speed_mps.label: Belt speed
belt_speed_mps.description: pi x driver diameter x rpm / 60000 (computed when not provided)

bending_freq_hz.label: Bending frequency
bending_freq_hz.description: Flex cycles per second = belt speed / pitch length x pulleys (computed)

elongation_pct.label: Elongation
elongation_pct.description: Permanent stretch: increase in pitch length vs. installed length

wear_pct.label: Sidewall wear
wear_pct.description: Sidewall wear as % of the allowable wear (e.g. groove ride-down vs. its limit)

crack_depth_mm.label: Crack depth
crack_depth_mm.description: Depth of the deepest underside/rib crack

rul_hours.label: Remaining useful life
rul_hours.description: Measured remaining operating hours until failure/replacement

failure_hour.label: Failure / replacement hour
failure_hour.description: Operating hour at which the belt actually failed or was replaced
